name: Translate to Turkish
description: A voice speaks what you say in Turkish. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 188 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Turkish model from the Argos Translate package index: Argos Translate (Argos Open Technologies), released under MIT or CC0 (argos-translate issue #533). Trained on OPUS data; includes a Stanza English tokenizer (Apache-2.0). Voice: Piper voice tr_TR-dfki-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
